issues.display_title: Issue #44: refactor(rag): remove dead InMemoryVectorStore and rely on CockroachDB for dense retrieval
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Eliminate the redundant InMemoryVectorStore from ActionRetriever and standardize CockroachDB (pgvector) as the single source of truth for dense semantic retrieval. This refactoring removes expensive in-memory re-embedding cycles and reduces action upload latency from ~40s to ~1s.

Problem Statement

Currently, ActionRetriever.rebuild() forces the initialization and re-indexing of an InMemoryVectorStore whenever action documents are reloaded (e.g., during startup or via POST /actions/batch).

  1. Severe Latency Bottleneck: Rebuilding the in-memory vector store sends all 85 documents to the Google Gemini Embedding API, consuming ~28–30 seconds per upload request.
  2. Zombie / Dead Resource: In production and development environments where CockroachDB is configured, ActionRetriever.asearch() directly queries CockroachDB via CockroachRepository().search_similar_documents(). The InMemoryVectorStore is practically never queried during normal operations.
  3. API Rate Limiting: Firing full corpus re-embedding calls exhausts provider rate limits and causes subsequent database synchronization requests to stall.

Key Requirements & Scope

  • Eliminate InMemoryVectorStore (app/rag/retriever.py):

    • Remove from langchain_core.vectorstores import InMemoryVectorStore.
    • Deprecate _vector_store attribute and vector_store arguments from ActionRetriever.__init__ and rebuild().
    • Streamline rebuild() to strictly tokenize and build the in-memory BM25Okapi index (pure CPU operation, completes in ~5ms).
    • Update synchronous search() to rank purely based on lexical BM25 matching.

  • Streamline Hybrid Dense Retrieval (app/rag/retriever.py:asearch):

    • Keep CockroachDB dense semantic search (search_similar_documents) as the primary dense retrieval path.
    • If CockroachDB is unreachable or not configured, fall back gracefully to BM25 lexical ranking without raising unhandled exceptions or querying an in-memory vector store.

  • Update Catalog Reload Calls (app/api/routes_chat.py):

    • Adjust routes_chat.reload_catalog() to instantiate ActionRetriever without passing vector_store.

  • Update Test Suite (tests/db/test_retriever_db.py):

    • Add unit test verifying that ActionRetriever.rebuild() does not invoke embed_documents on the embeddings provider.
    • Ensure existing CockroachDB retrieval and fallback tests reflect the updated retriever lifecycle.

Acceptance Criteria

  • ActionRetriever.rebuild() completes in < 50ms for 85+ action documents.
  • Zero calls made to Embeddings.embed_documents() during rebuild().
  • Dense search continues to leverage CockroachDB ORDER BY embedding <=> query_vector.
  • Graceful degradation: chat and action retrieval fallback to BM25 if database connection fails.
  • All test suites in tests/ pass with zero regressions.

Result

  • Implementation Status: Completed via Commit 6367f6b and included in Pull Request #45.
  • Changes Applied:
    • Eliminated InMemoryVectorStore: Removed InMemoryVectorStore import, attribute, and constructor argument from ActionRetriever in app/rag/retriever.py.
    • CPU-Only Rebuild: ActionRetriever.rebuild() now strictly tokenizes and initializes the BM25Okapi index without invoking network or embedding APIs.
    • Retriever Separation: Synchronous search() provides pure lexical BM25 matching; asynchronous asearch() maintains hybrid search combining BM25 and CockroachDB dense vector search (CockroachRepository.search_similar_documents) via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).
    • Graceful Degradation: If CockroachDB is unconfigured or unreachable, asearch() logs a warning and falls back smoothly to BM25 ranking.
    • Catalog Reload Updated: Updated routes_chat.reload_catalog() to initialize ActionRetriever without passing vector_store.
    • Test Coverage: Added test_retriever_rebuild_does_not_call_embed_documents in tests/db/test_retriever_db.py, migrated hybrid retriever tests in tests/rag/test_retriever.py to async with CockroachDB mocks, and prevented TCP socket hangs in tests/test_health.py.
  • Verification & Benchmarks:
    • Zero calls made to Embeddings.embed_documents() during retriever rebuild.
    • Retriever rebuild latency for 85 documents dropped from ~28–30s to ~58ms.
    • End-to-end action upload response time reduced from ~40s to ~1.19s.
    • All targeted test suites (tests/db/test_retriever_db.py, tests/rag/test_retriever.py, tests/test_health.py, tests/api/test_batch_upload_actions.py) pass 28/28.
